source_hashes.boundaries: end psi 0/v and q=1; wall psi=v*x/L+w*sin²(pi*x/L), zero ion flux; regular axis

scientific_scope: Forced analytic verification only; legacy charged-wall domain HOLD unchanged
cost_interpretation: Cached-grid replay of frozen selection rules. Sum all construction-plus-solve costs required by each policy, plus its own measured selection time. File I/O, reference evaluation and plotting excluded. No randomized repeated-runtime or universal speedup claim.
